description.partner: The dashboard address you and your customers use, and your customers' public domains.
description.workspace: Own domains for this workspace's public pages: site, digital profile and quiz.

dashboard.title: Dashboard domain
dashboard.description: Change the dashboard address, for example from console.guidu.co to console.yourcompany.com. It applies to /admin and to your customers' dashboard.

customers.title: Customer domains
customers.description: Public domains of your customers' workspaces. Each workspace's limit comes from its plan.
customers.empty: No customer has its own domain.

public.title: Public domains
public.description: Use a subdomain, such as profile.yourcompany.com. The primary domain is the address used in public links.
public.quotaNone: The current plan does not include an own domain. Talk to whoever manages your account.
public.readOnly: Only the workspace owner and admins change the domains.

form.removeMessage: The address stops opening at once and its certificate is deleted.

instructions.title: How to point it
instructions.cname: In the domain's DNS, create a CNAME record named {host} pointing to {target}. Then click Verify.
instructions.noTarget: The CNAME target is not configured on the platform yet. The domain stays pending until then.

messages.added: Domain {host} added. Point the CNAME and click Verify.
messages.not_configured: Verification is not configured on the platform yet.
messages.dns_pending: The CNAME does not point to the target yet. DNS propagation can take a few hours.
messages.ssl_pending: DNS is correct. The certificate is being issued; verify again in a few minutes.
messages.ssl_error: The certificate was not issued. Check the CNAME and verify again.
messages.cloudflare_error: The certificate could not be registered now. Try again.
messages.baseAdded: Domain {host} added. Create the CNAME records and click Verify.
messages.wildcard_pending: The domain points to the target, but the wildcard (*.) does not yet. DNS propagation can take a few hours.

errors.invalidDomain: Enter a valid domain, such as profile.yourcompany.com.
errors.platformDomain: This domain belongs to the platform.
errors.primaryNotActive: Only an active domain can be the primary one.
errors.invalidBaseDomain: Enter a valid domain, such as card.yourcompany.com.
errors.housePartner: The platform's default domain is set by operations.
errors.baseExists: There is already a default domain for this type. Remove it first.
errors.choiceNotActive: Only an active domain can be chosen.

addresses.title: Default addresses
addresses.description: Each type of public page already has an address with the workspace name. It does not count toward the plan's domain limit.
addresses.unavailable: Unavailable for this workspace's name. Use your own domain.
addresses.off: This type has no default domain yet.

bases.title: Customers' default domains
bases.description: Each customer gets a subdomain with the workspace name on the default domain of each type. Add a domain of yours to replace the platform's for your customers.
bases.platformOff: No platform domain for this type.
bases.instructions: In DNS, create two CNAME records pointing to {target}: one named {host} and another named *.{host}. Then click Verify.
bases.certificate: The wildcard certificate of this domain is set up by the platform's operations team.
bases.removeMessage: Your customers' addresses on this domain stop opening and go back to the platform domain.
bases.house: The platform's default domains apply to the house customers and are set by operations.
bases.readOnly: Only the partner's owner and admins change the default domains.

picker.label: Domain
picker.none: No public address. Add your own domain.
